description: A small metal dish rack with a shallow tray sits on a green tablecloth, holding a pile of colorful plastic utensils. The left hand reaches in from the left, grasps a bundle of utensils from the tray, lifts them up and out, and sets them down on the table in front; it then returns to the tray to remove more utensils and adds them to the growing pile, leaving the tray mostly empty.
